_comment: Copy to ~/.config/spark-monitor/estop-agent.json and edit. Only needed when the thing you want to pause runs somewhere other than the dashboard host - otherwise use hooks in profiles.json. Guide: docs/ESTOP.md.
_comment_token: Must match control.token on the dashboard. Leave null and set SPARK_MONITOR_TOKEN in the environment instead if you would rather not have it in a file.
_comment_commands: Any shell command. {profile} and {reason} are substituted. Leave pause_command null to connect and acknowledge without pausing anything - useful for a first run.
_comment_paused: Optional. Exit 0 means 'currently paused'. Without it the agent tracks its own state in memory, which is fine until it restarts mid-switch.
